title: Extreme values of central $L$-derivatives and heights of Heegner points
body_text:
Extreme values of central $L$-derivatives and heights of Heegner points

Using Soundararajan's resonance method, we obtain extreme values of the central derivatives \[ L^{(r)}(1/2,f\otimesχ_d), \] where $f$ is a normalized newform and $χ_d$ ranges over primitive real characters associated with negative fundamental discriminants. The twisted first moment estimate used in the proof may be of independent interest. Applying Gross--Zagier-type formulas, we obtain correspondingly large Néron--Tate heights of Heegner points on elliptic curves and large absolute values of Beilinson--Bloch heights of Heegner cycles attached to modular forms.

Authors: Mohammad H. Hamdar, Sun-Kai Leung
Categories: math.NT, math.NT
